# APC 9x4.5MR blade geometry

`9x45MR-PERF.PE0`: APC's published geometry and performance file for the 9x4.5MR (chord, pitch, twist, sweep,
rake, thickness ratio by radial station, in inches). Extracted unchanged from `PE0-FILES_WEB-202602.zipx`
(https://www.apcprop.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/PE0-FILES_WEB-202602.zipx, linked from
https://www.apcprop.com/technical-information/file-downloads/), downloaded 2026-11-15. File header: v2025-1001,
simulation date 02/24/2026. Used to model PRP-002 blades in the concept A CAD.
